title: Hoop Bounce – Free One-Tap Basketball Game (Play in Your Browser)
description: Play Hoop Bounce free in your browser: tap to bounce a cute basketball into a moving hoop, chain clean swishes for fire combos and grab the golden ball.
body: Hoop Bounce is a one-tap basketball game. Every tap bounces the ball up and a little towards the hoop; your job is to time the taps so the ball drops through the hoop from above. Miss the floor and keep it in the air.

Clean shots that touch nothing (swishes) build a combo: each one is worth more than the last, and from the second swish in a row (×3) the ball catches fire. After every basket the hoop jumps to the other side of the court, then it starts sliding sideways, moving up and down and slowly shrinking. Touch the rim three times or let the ball hit the floor and the run is over.

Runs last one to three minutes, there is no text, and it plays well in portrait and landscape on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and desktops. Coins from every basket unlock new balls (watermelon, planet, emoji faces and more), nets and courts.
New here? Read how to play and the tips for bigger combos.

title: How to Play Hoop Bounce – Tap Controls, Combos, Lives and the Golden Ball
description: Hoop Bounce controls and rules: tap to bounce, score from above, swishes multiply your points, three rim hits end the run, and the golden ball doubles everything.
body: Controls. Tap or click anywhere on the screen. On a keyboard, use Space, Up or W. At the start the ball floats in the middle of the court and waits for your first tap.

Each tap throws the ball upwards and nudges it towards the hoop: the further away the hoop is, the bigger the sideways nudge. Between taps, gravity pulls the ball down. The ball bounces off the side walls and the backboard.

Scoring. The ball counts only when it falls into the hoop from above. If you come up from underneath, the net pushes the ball back out towards the middle of the court. After each basket the hoop moves to the other side.

Combo. A basket that touches neither the rim nor the backboard is a swish and raises the multiplier (×2, ×3, ×4...). Each basket is worth the current multiplier, so a long chain of swishes adds up fast. Touching the rim or the board resets it. From ×3 the ball is on fire.

Lives. The three little balls under your coins are your rim hits. Every hard touch on the rim costs one, and the third one ends the run. Three swishes in a row give one back. Letting the ball fall to the floor also ends the run.

Golden ball. Every 20 to 30 seconds a golden star orb appears in the middle of the court for a few seconds. Bounce into it and for 8 seconds your ball turns gold: every basket is worth double and gives extra coins.
The hoop gets harder. For the first three baskets it stands still; then it slides sideways, then moves up and down, and later does both, a little faster each time, while the rim slowly gets narrower.

title: Hoop Bounce Tips: Longer Combos and Higher Scores
description: Practical tips for Hoop Bounce: come in from the side, tap at the top of the bounce, wait for the drop, protect your lives and use the golden ball well.
body: Come in from the side, never from below. Taps aim the ball at the hoop, so a shot from directly underneath goes straight into the net. Stay a little to one side and let the arc carry the ball over the rim.
Fewer taps are better. Each tap resets the ball's upward speed. When the ball is already above the hoop and drifting in, do nothing and let it drop.
Aim for the middle of the rim. The rim edges are the danger. A ball that drops through the centre is a swish; one that clips the edge costs a life and resets the combo.
Watch the hoop's rhythm. Moving hoops swing in a steady pattern. Tap when the hoop is heading towards you and the ball will meet it.
Protect your lives first. If you are down to one life, take safe shots. Three swishes in a row give a life back, which is worth more than a risky multiplier.
Save the golden ball for the combo. Points are combo × 2 while it lasts, so grabbing it in the middle of a swish chain is worth a lot.
Use the walls. When the hoop is near the side, the wall and backboard stop the ball. A gentle bounce off the wall can set up a soft drop.

title: Hoop Bounce FAQ
description: Answers about Hoop Bounce: is it free, does it save, does it work on phones and Chromebooks, why did my shot not count, and what the golden ball does.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser. There is nothing to buy: new balls, nets and courts are unlocked with coins you earn by playing.
Does it save my progress? Yes. Your best score, your coins and your unlocked items are stored in your browser (on CrazyGames, in your account).
Does it work on phones, in portrait and on Chromebooks? Yes. It is made for one finger, and also works with a mouse or the keyboard, in portrait or landscape.
Why did my shot not count? The ball must fall into the hoop from above. A ball that rises through the bottom of the net is pushed back out.
Why did I lose a life without missing? A hard touch on the rim costs a life even if the ball then drops in. Clean swishes are the safe way to score.
What is the golden ball? A golden star orb that appears now and then. Touch it with the ball and for 8 seconds every basket counts double and gives extra coins.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.

title: Hoop Bounce for Schools and Kids – Safe, Short, No Sign-up
description: Hoop Bounce is a short, text-free basketball game that works on school Chromebooks: no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data.
h1: Hoop Bounce for classrooms and kids
body: Hoop Bounce has no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data. A run lasts one to three minutes, which makes it a good short break between tasks.
There is no text in the game, only numbers and pictures, so it works the same for children who are still learning to read and for students of any language.

It trains timing and prediction: players watch a simple bouncing arc, learn how gravity bends it and plan each tap so the ball lands where the hoop will be. The combo multiplier (×2, ×3, ×4) gives a little mental multiplication along the way.
It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones, in portrait or landscape, and loads in a couple of seconds (1.6 MB).
